lessons.lesson: Do not promise outcomes or timelines the business has not approved. Offer the earliest date after an inspection instead.
Read prices from data/business.json every time you write one. Never reuse a remembered or cached price.
If a lead has no personal name, greet the company or use a neutral hello. Never send a draft with a template field left in it.
Check every proposed visit against business hours before writing it. If a customer says 'weekend', offer Saturday morning.
When a call summary shows a price that differs from the price list, flag it for the owner. Do not repeat it in a follow-up.
